text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: streaming proxy 'ingest-proxy-1' p99 tail latency spike > 5s over last 2m. Auto-paging oncall.

maya_oncall: I'm paged, joining. What's the impact? Any customers affected?

sam_platform: Observed SSE chunk delays and socket stalls. p95 up from 120ms -> 1.6s, p99 4.8s. Error rate is flat. No deploys in last 30m.

rachel_sre: Adding traces. Looks like proxy write buffers piling up. Downstream consumers show slow READs (client backpressure).

maya_oncall: Can we get a tail sample of streaming connections? curl logs?  

sam_platform: grabbing tcpdump and proxy metrics. Dumping top 20 slow streams to S3: s3://redwood-debug/6791234567/streams.txt

ingest-proxy: Log extract:
```
2026-03-15T10:42:12Z WARN write to socket delayed 3300ms id=xy-123
2026-03-15T10:42:13Z INFO client-window 0 id=xy-123
2026-03-15T10:42:14Z WARN flush backpressure id=xy-123
```

rachel_sre: Pattern: a small subset of clients (long-lived mobile SDKs) not reading due to flaky cellular. Proxy keeps buffers and that stalls internal circuit (coalesced writes). We have no per-connection soft drop yet.

maya_oncall: Live mitigation options? Reduce per-connection buffer, enable writeback drop policy, or short-circuit to non-streaming fallback.

sam_platform: I can flip keepalive/timeouts to more aggressive: set proxy.client_idle_timeout=30s and proxy.stream_buffer_limit=64KB. Rolling patch ready.

maya_oncall: Do it in canary region first (eu-west-1). Notify ops-bot when done.

ops-bot: Deploy started: patch/proxy/corking-fix -> canary (eu-west-1). CI OK. ETA ~3m.

sam_platform: Canary applied. Monitoring p95/p99.

maya_oncall: Any immediate customer-visible mitigation? We can enable server-side gap-fill (send heartbeat chunk) to keep sockets alive.

eve_customer_success: We have 2 live customers on affected cluster. Reached out to AE to let them know we're investigating.

sam_platform: Canary metrics: p95 reduced to 270ms, p99 down to 600ms in canary.

rachel_sre: Good. Rolling to remaining pods with 10% batch and 1m pause.

ops-bot: Rollout progress: 30% -> 70% -> done.

sam_platform: Roll complete. Post-roll p95 210ms, p99 480ms. No increase in request errors.

maya_oncall: Closing the paging if metrics stable for 10m. Captured traces and will open a follow-up to add per-connection soft-drop and better metrics for 'stalled-client' classification.

rachel_sre: Filing follow-up: INC-6791234567 - add per-conn buffer circuit-breaker, surface stalled_client metric, and run canary tests with mobile SDK patterns.

eve_customer_success: Sending customer note: "Mitigated streaming stalls; we rolled a proxy fix and are monitoring. Please reach out if you see more issues." 

maya_oncall: Closing incident. Thanks team :clap:

ops-bot: Incident resolved and marked 'resolved' by maya_oncall at 2026-03-15T10:58:00Z. Incident duration ~16m.
